AGENDA
REGULAR MEETING OF THE PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item.Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City’s website under Parklands Committee Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.
The Parklands Committee, at the direction of the Committee Chair with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be continued to future Parklands Committee meetings.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
PUBLIC WORK DIRECTOR'S REPORT
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
CITIZEN APPLICATION
1.
PC-577-24; APPLICATION TO REMOVE SIX PERUVIAN PEPPER TREES LOCATED IN THE PARKWAYS ON EPPING ROAD ADJACENT TO 2100 PASEO DEL MAR AND 2101 CHELSEA ROAD
Applicant: Sally and Kirby Larson, 2101 Chelsea Road, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommendation: That the Parklands Committee consider the following available actions: (1) Approve the request to remove the six Peruvian Pepper trees and approve the Conditions of Approval; (2) Deny the request to remove the six Peruvian Pepper trees; or (3) Provide alternative direction.
Staff Report
Revised Staff Report
2.
PC-CTP-14-24; CONCEPT PLAN FOR A HABITAT MITIGATION FOR WEST BASIN RECYCLED WATER
PIPELINE PROJECT
Applicant: Palos Verdes Golf Club-David Stocke, 3301 Via Campesina, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommendation: That the Parklands Committee consider the following available actions: (1) Approve the Concept Plan for a Change to Parklands; (2) Deny the Concept Plan for a Change to Parklands; or (3) Provide alternative direction.
Staff Report
Revised Staff Report
3.
PC-581-24; APPLICATION TO TRIM AS LOW AS POSSIBLE THREE GROUPINGS OF LEMONADE BERRY SHRUBS LOCATED ON THE BLUFF EDGE ACROSS FROM 1640 PASEO DEL MAR
Applicant: Steven Prado, 1640 Paseo Del Mar, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommendation: That the Parklands Committee consider the following available actions: (1) Approve the request to trim as low as possible four groupings of Lemonade Berry shrubs, and approve the Conditions of Approval; (2) Deny the request to trim as low as possible four groupings of Lemonade Berry shrubs; or (3) Provide alternative direction.
Staff Report
4.
PC-580-24; APPLICATION TO REMOVE FOUR TREES AND ONE SHRUB LOCATED IN THE PUBLIC RIGHT-OF-WAY AND PARKLANDS ADJACENT
TO 841 TYBURN ROAD AND PLANT FIVE REPLACEMENT TREES
Applicant: Allan Rigg, 6415 Via Canada, Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275
On behalf of Michael and Melinda Limas
Recommendation: That the Parklands Committee consider the following actions: (1) Approve the request to remove four trees and one shrub and plant five replacement trees, and approve the Conditions of Approval, (2) Deny the request to remove four trees and one shrub and plant five replacement trees; or (3) Provide alternative direction.
Staff Report
OLD BUSINESS
None.
COMMITTEE CHAIR AND COMMITTEE MEMBER REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Committee Chair and Committee Members to provide comments, reports on community activities, subcommittees, and proposed topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
ADJOURNMENT TO THURSDAY, November 14, 2024, AT 6:30 P.M.

Dated this 5th day of September 2024. Tameka Cook, City Clerk
